install.title: Get the app on your phone
install.subtitle: A one-page, printable handout with a QR code and home-screen install steps — hand it to a parent at the office, or attach it to a WhatsApp or email.
install.printTip: In the print dialog, set Margins: None and switch off Headers and footers — the sheet carries its own margins.

installGuide.title: Install the <school>{name}</school> app on your phone
installGuide.lede: No app store, no download — the portal installs straight from your browser in about a minute.
installGuide.scanBody: Open the camera app on your phone, point it at the code, and tap the link that pops up.
installGuide.typeBody: Open Chrome or Safari on your phone and enter this address exactly as written:
installGuide.thenAdd: Then add it to your home screen

android.step1Body: Scan the code or type the address into Google Chrome.
android.step2Body: A banner slides up from the bottom of the screen once the portal loads.
android.step3Body: Tap the three dots ⋮ in the top-right corner and choose Add to Home screen.
android.step4Body: The app icon appears on your home screen, ready to open.

ios.step1Body: Scan the code or type the address into Safari on your iPhone or iPad.
ios.step2Body: The share button sits in the bar at the bottom of the screen.
ios.step3Body: Scroll down the list of options until you find it.
ios.step4Body: It’s in the top-right corner. The app icon appears on your home screen.

installGuide.footer: Once installed, the app opens full-screen, keeps you signed in, and can send you notices from the school.
